publisher: MassDOT Office of Transportation Planning / Central Transportation Planning Staff
coverage: statewide all public roads plus many private roads (speed populated only where a limit is recorded)
license: none stated; MassDOT catalog says road attributes are 'not a legal record', planning purposes only
notes: Confirmed speed fields on MassDOT-org AGOL layers (VRU_Map_Final_WFL1/10; also gis.crashdata.dot.mass.gov IMPACT_RISK_FACTORS/FeatureServer/11 has speed_lim). Canonical statewide download is MassGIS-MassDOT Roads (shapefile https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download.massgis.digital.mass.gov/shapefiles/state/MassDOT_Roads_SHP.zip, gdb ..._GDB.zip, updated 2025-01-16) but its page did not confirm a speed field; check Road Inventory data dictionary. MassDOT also has a SpeedRegInventory service on gisstg.massdot.state.ma.us (not reachable). Many roads have no speed regulation (statutory defaults apply).
